hotspots.title: Trump Waiver of Russia Sanctions Sparks Outrage
hotspots.blurb: President Trump defended temporary waivers of Russian energy sanctions, arguing they aid peace talks while accusing Ukrainian leaders of prolonging the war. The moves have ignited fierce criticism from allies and domestic opponents.
hotspots.affect: The story fuels a moral panic about national security and betrayal, with polarized accusations and alarmist framing dominating coverage.

hotspots.title: Trump Rally Tour Fuels Midterm Fever
hotspots.blurb: Donald Trump embarked on a nationwide rally blitz, hitting swing‑state battlegrounds and endorsing vulnerable Senate candidates ahead of the 2026 midterms. The tour is portrayed as a high‑stakes push to shape election outcomes.
hotspots.affect: Intense partisan fervor and triumph‑laden rhetoric make the rally circuit a flashpoint of outrage and excitement across right‑wing media.

hotspots.title: JD Vance Campaign Rhetoric Sparks Sharp Backlash
hotspots.blurb: Vice President JD Vance faced mounting criticism for his hard‑line immigration stance, highlighted by a Catholic sister’s confrontation and media denunciations of his dehumanizing language.
hotspots.affect: The backlash is framed as a moral fight over immigrant rights, generating outrage‑coded language and polarized debate.

hotspots.title: Trump Executive Defiance Over Capital City Projects
hotspots.blurb: Trump ordered the reopening of the East Potomac golf course and pushed a 250‑foot triumphal arch in D.C., directly defying judicial orders and sparking legal battles over historic preservation and environmental concerns.
hotspots.affect: The narrative pits executive overreach against institutional checks, amplifying a tone of defiance and confrontation.

hotspots.title: Trump Farm & Rural Aid Funding Push
hotspots.blurb: The administration unveiled an $8 billion farm relief plan and linked rural health dollars to state hospital‑law reforms, prompting debate over spending priorities and federal overreach in agricultural policy.
hotspots.affect: Economic anxiety and accusations of political bribery create a charged backdrop, with stakeholders framing the measures as coercive and partisan.
